entries.fc54f4c348c8f856: Under the “2026 Vision,” which looks ahead to the 90th anniversary of its founding in 2027, it is advancing the 10th Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027). Its three basic strategies are: restructuring its business portfolio toward a decarbonized society (expanding equipment that contributes to CO2 emission reduction and equipment with high resilience); expanding its business domain from “ease” to “enjoyment” through products and services that reduce household chores and products and services in the outdoor field; and restructuring its management base (reviewing internal systems and work practices and improving job fulfillment).
